meta.scope: Turkey Batch 8 — Health (life expectancy) and poverty / living conditions densification.

candidates.title: Life expectancy and vital statistics
candidates.description: Official life tables and life expectancy at birth. Recent estimates place life expectancy at birth around 78.1 years (2022–2024 period), with females living substantially longer than males.

candidates.title: Poverty and living conditions statistics
candidates.description: Official relative poverty rates and living-conditions indicators from household surveys. Relative poverty rate has been reported in the low-to-mid teens in recent releases; absolute poverty has declined substantially over the longer term while regional disparities persist.
candidates.notes: Core welfare measurement node. Interacts tightly with inflation and regional disparity.

candidates.title: Social protection and assistance framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from national and development sources
candidates.description: Policy and statistical framing of social assistance, cash transfers and related social-protection programmes. Continuously referenced in poverty-reduction and equity analysis, especially under high-inflation conditions.
candidates.notes: Social-protection densification linked to the poverty and fiscal clusters.

candidates.title: Turkey health–poverty densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from TurkStat and social sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding life expectancy and vital statistics, poverty and living-conditions statistics, and social-protection framing into a coherent health and welfare layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
CPI, labour, lagging-regions and fiscal series from earlier batches
candidates.notes: Integrating node for the health and poverty densification pass.
